svg.title: NovaVision integrated pipeline
svg.desc: The app analyzes English text, builds a prompt using emotion and affect estimates alongside the original text and selected style, and renders an image. It returns the image, prompt, seed, and backend. Experiments supply known targets and paired prompt tiers to the same prompt builder and renderer. Only experiment images enter the image probe. Probe estimates and known targets enter comparison, which produces recovery and affect results, saved records, and charts. The app does not use probe predictions to revise its images. Affect targets are priors or text estimates; probe scores are not human ratings.
